facts_transferred.global_model_rule: NIST NCSTAR 1-6D modeled individually only core beams framed with moment connections; non-moment beam axial stiffness was combined with the in-plane slab stiffness.
facts_transferred.global_model_local_redistribution: NIST reports that the composite floor representation could redistribute load locally among neighboring columns.
facts_transferred.floor96_full_floor_model: NIST NCSTAR 1-6C modeled the Floor 96 core beams and slab explicitly; Floor 96 was treated as typical of the upper floors.
facts_transferred.beam_steel_material: NIST NCSTAR 1-6C Material ID 2: all 36 ksi core WF, channels and tubes; room-temperature model yield 37.0 ksi and ultimate 63.45 ksi.
facts_transferred.beam_schedule_source: NIST NCSTAR 1-2A identifies WTCAB-Bk5-BeamSched.xls and WTCAB_DBk5.mdb, but neither file was found in the local source archive.
facts_transferred.connection_schedule_source: NIST NCSTAR 1-2A identifies Drawing Book 6 core-bracing/connection data, but the relevant files were not found in the local source archive.

beam_schedule.source: AISC historic WF properties already extracted and hash-recorded for V8B
beam_schedule.selection_basis: Wide low/middle/high mechanical bracket using available historic WF rows; the actual Book 5 member schedule is required to replace it.

moment_topology.applies_to: global-model moment-connected core beams at each office floor in the modeled upper-story range
moment_topology.note: Absence from this edge list means absence from the individually modeled moment-beam subnetwork, not absence of all floor framing.

proxy_topology.name: nearest_four_connected_proxy
proxy_topology.construction: Union of the four nearest reconstructed core-column neighbors for every core column.
proxy_topology.purpose: Connected sensitivity envelope for omitted non-moment beams and slab load paths; not an as-built framing transcription.

mechanical_law.plastic_modulus_proxy: Zx reconstructed from rectangular flange and web dimensions; fillets omitted
mechanical_law.warning: The connection factors and rotation limit are sensitivity assumptions because Book 6 details are missing.

model_assumptions.vertical_coupling: stable column-spring reactions at one story become nodal loads at the story below
model_assumptions.column_support: elastic axial spring EA/L capped by the V8B nominal temperature-reduced column capacity
model_assumptions.column_failure_history: fractured beam links persist within a story cascade; plastic offsets are recalculated after each column removal
model_assumptions.beam_temperature_proxy: endpoint mean uses synthetic column temperatures because beam temperature histories are unavailable

v8f_uncapped_reference.case: 100 min, gamma 1, local four, NIST removals only, amplification 1.0
